title: Escape or replace world overlay prefix LIKE query
description: Review finding from loreweaver-niw. worldQuery uses LIKE prefix matching for overlay keys without escaping, so ids containing _ or % can apply overlays to the wrong template record. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay lookup handles ids containing _ and % safely; tests prove only exact target overlays are applied; implementation uses escaped LIKE with ESCAPE, stricter ids, or delimiter-safe lookup.
notes: RED: new test matches overlay keys exactly when ids contain LIKE wildcards failed - id gob_lin folded in gobXlin overlay because _ was a LIKE wildcard. GREEN: escapeLikePrefix + LIKE ? ESCAPE in worldQuery; all 200 pass.
close_reason: Verified merged: PR #19 (67y) and PR #22 (8uh) are merged to main; re-closing after beads-state drift reverted the original closes.
